market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Hot CPI + Fed hike expectations pressure equities; oil surge supports energy but inflates input costs. AI safety narrative creates tech volatility. SaaS names face continued selling. Gold and bonds offer relative strength. Expect 3-5% equity drawdown risk into Fed meeting.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI infrastructure capex supercycle (Nvidia, Alphabet) remains intact despite safety noise. Energy transition accelerates with LNG expansion. Defense spending structural. Key risk: if Hormuz fully closes, stagflation scenario emerges, forcing aggressive Fed response that could trigger recession.
